pass_rule: Correlation/overlap diagnostics performed; double-counting or near-duplicate signals are documented and addressed.
interpretation_rule: High correlation or evidence overlap is a review trigger, not proof of conceptual redundancy. Human review must distinguish shared source/evidence effects from genuinely duplicated constructs.
blockers_to_start: No frozen real Pilot 20 reconciled indicator matrix exists.
G03/G04 real scoring and reconciliation have not occurred.
No real shared-evidence overlap report exists.
No human conceptual review of flagged indicator pairs has occurred.
human_gate: Only authorised methodological review may retain, revise, merge, split or reweight an indicator after redundancy diagnostics.
